sonnet.problem: This joke repeats the idea and punchline shape of Stop 1 card 12. Both set the forty days Moses spends on the mountain against Papa Dorin's own habits ("Forty DAYS, friend, and I can't go forty MINUTES..." vs. "this man spends more time on that mountain than I spend in front of my ovens"). The second version also doesn't hold together: a stamper who says he LIVES in front of his ovens can't spend less time there than Moses spent on one 40-day trip.
sonnet.rule: Each joke idea, comparison and punchline shape is used once per lesson. A callback is the one exception, and it adds something new.
